import Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.ZMod
import Mathlib.Tactic

open scoped BigOperators

namespace SignalAudit

noncomputable section

variable {P : Nat} [NeZero P]

def unitIndicator (k : ZMod P) : Complex := by
  classical
  exact if IsUnit k then 1 else 0

def ramanujan (h : ZMod P) : Complex :=
  ZMod.dft (unitIndicator (P := P)) h

def selector (k : ZMod P) : Complex :=
  (1 / (P : Complex)) *
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun h : ZMod P =>
      ramanujan h * ZMod.stdAddChar (k * h))

def baseline (k : ZMod P) : Complex :=
  (1 / (P : Complex)) *
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun h : ZMod P => ZMod.stdAddChar (k * h))

theorem ramanujan_sum (h : ZMod P) :
    ramanujan h = Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a : ZMod P =>
      if IsUnit a then ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * h)) else 0) := by
  classical
  simp [ramanujan, ZMod.dft_apply, unitIndicator, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite]

theorem selector_eq_indicator (k : ZMod P) :
    selector k = unitIndicator k := by
  have h : (ZMod.dft).symm (ZMod.dft (unitIndicator (P := P))) k =
      unitIndicator k := by simp
  simpa only [selector, ramanujan, ZMod.invDFT_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    one_div, mul_comm] using h

theorem baseline_formula (k : ZMod P) :
    baseline k = if k = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [baseline, hk, ZMod.card]
  · rw [baseline, AddChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one (ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar P hk)]
    simp [hk]

theorem joint_transform (q gamma d : Complex) (k : ZMod P) :
    (1 / (P : Complex)) *
      Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun h : ZMod P =>
        (q + gamma * ramanujan h * d) * ZMod.stdAddChar (k * h)) =
      q * (if k = 0 then 1 else 0) + gamma * d * unitIndicator k := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = q * baseline k + gamma * d * selector k := by
      unfold baseline selector
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [<- Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro h _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [baseline_formula, selector_eq_indicator]

theorem intCast_isUnit_iff (m : Int) :
    IsUnit (m : ZMod P) <-> Nat.Coprime m.natAbs P := by
  cases m with
  | ofNat n => simpa using (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n P)
  | negSucc n =>
      simpa [Int.negSucc_eq] using (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime (n + 1) P)

theorem integer_selector (m : Int) :
    selector (m : ZMod P) = if Nat.Coprime m.natAbs P then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [selector_eq_indicator]
  simp only [unitIndicator, intCast_isUnit_iff]

def sievePrimes (K : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (Finset.range (K + 1)).filter Nat.Prime

def sieveModulus (K : Nat) : Nat :=
  (sievePrimes K).prod (fun p => p)

theorem sieveModulus_pos (K : Nat) : 0 < sieveModulus K := by
  unfold sieveModulus
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.pos

theorem prime_dvd_sieveModulus (K p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hK : p <= K) :
    p ∣ sieveModulus K := by
  unfold sieveModulus
  apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
  simp [sievePrimes, hp, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hK]

theorem exists_sieve_modulus (K : Nat) (hK : 2 <= K) :
    Exists fun Q : Nat =>
      2 <= Q /\ (forall p : Nat, Nat.Prime p -> p <= K -> p ∣ Q) := by
  refine ⟨sieveModulus K, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.le_of_dvd (sieveModulus_pos K)
      (prime_dvd_sieveModulus K 2 Nat.prime_two hK)
  · intro p hp hle
    exact prime_dvd_sieveModulus K p hp hle

theorem harmonic_not_unit (K ell : Nat)
    (cover : forall p : Nat, Nat.Prime p -> p <= K -> p ∣ P)
    (h2 : 2 <= ell) (hK : ell <= K) (m : ZMod P) :
    Not (IsUnit ((ell : ZMod P) * m)) := by
  intro hu
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime ell P :=
    (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime ell P).mp (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu)
  let p := Nat.minFac ell
  have hp : Nat.Prime p := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  have hd : p ∣ ell := Nat.minFac_dvd ell
  have hsmall : p <= K := (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < ell) hd).trans hK
  have hP : p ∣ P := cover p hp hsmall
  have hg : p ∣ Nat.gcd ell P := Nat.dvd_gcd hd hP
  have hone : p ∣ 1 := by simpa only [hcop.gcd_eq_one] using hg
  have hle : p <= 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 1) hone
  have htwo : 2 <= p := hp.two_le
  omega

theorem higher_mode_zero (K ell : Nat)
    (cover : forall p : Nat, Nat.Prime p -> p <= K -> p ∣ P)
    (h2 : 2 <= ell) (hK : ell <= K) (m : Int) :
    selector ((ell : ZMod P) * (m : ZMod P)) = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [selector_eq_indicator]
  simp only [unitIndicator, if_neg (harmonic_not_unit K ell cover h2 hK (m : ZMod P))]

end

end SignalAudit

      q * (if k = 0 then 1 else 0) + gamma * d * unitIndicator k := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = q * baseline k + gamma * d * selector k := by
      unfold baseline selector
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [<- Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro h _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [baseline_formula, selector_eq_indicator]

theorem intCast_isUnit_iff (m : Int) :
    IsUnit (m : ZMod P) <-> Nat.Coprime m.natAbs P := by
  cases m with
  | ofNat n => simpa using (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n P)
  | negSucc n =>
      rw [Int.cast_negSucc, IsUnit.neg_iff]
      exact ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime (n + 1) P

theorem integer_selector (m : Int) :
    selector (m : ZMod P) = if Nat.Coprime m.natAbs P then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [selector_eq_indicator]
  simp only [unitIndicator, intCast_isUnit_iff]

def sievePrimes (K : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (Finset.range (K + 1)).filter Nat.Prime

def sieveModulus (K : Nat) : Nat :=
  (sievePrimes K).prod (fun p => p)

theorem sieveModulus_pos (K : Nat) : 0 < sieveModulus K := by
  unfold sieveModulus
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro p hp
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.pos

theorem prime_dvd_sieveModulus (K p : Nat) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hK : p <= K) :
    p ∣ sieveModulus K := by
  unfold sieveModulus
  apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
  simp [sievePrimes, hp, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hK]

theorem exists_sieve_modulus (K : Nat) (hK : 2 <= K) :
    Exists fun Q : Nat =>
      2 <= Q /\ (forall p : Nat, Nat.Prime p -> p <= K -> p ∣ Q) := by
  refine ⟨sieveModulus K, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Nat.le_of_dvd (sieveModulus_pos K)
      (prime_dvd_sieveModulus K 2 Nat.prime_two hK)
  · intro p hp hle
    exact prime_dvd_sieveModulus K p hp hle

theorem harmonic_not_unit (K ell : Nat)
    (cover : forall p : Nat, Nat.Prime p -> p <= K -> p ∣ P)
    (h2 : 2 <= ell) (hK : ell <= K) (m : ZMod P) :
    Not (IsUnit ((ell : ZMod P) * m)) := by
  intro hu
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime ell P :=
    (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime ell P).mp (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu)
  let p := Nat.minFac ell
  have hp : Nat.Prime p := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
  have hd : p ∣ ell := Nat.minFac_dvd ell
  have hsmall : p <= K := (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega : 0 < ell) hd).trans hK
  have hP : p ∣ P := cover p hp hsmall
  have hg : p ∣ Nat.gcd ell P := Nat.dvd_gcd hd hP
  have hone : p ∣ 1 := by simpa only [hcop.gcd_eq_one] using hg
  have hle : p <= 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 1) hone
  have htwo : 2 <= p := hp.two_le
  omega

theorem higher_mode_zero (K ell : Nat)
    (cover : forall p : Nat, Nat.Prime p -> p <= K -> p ∣ P)
    (h2 : 2 <= ell) (hK : ell <= K) (m : Int) :
    selector ((ell : ZMod P) * (m : ZMod P)) = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [selector_eq_indicator]
  simp only [unitIndicator, if_neg (harmonic_not_unit K ell cover h2 hK (m : ZMod P))]

end

end SignalAudit

claims.natural_statement: For every b>0 and smooth compactly supported Hermitian d on R minus zero, choose alpha=b/4, D above b and the support radius, L>max(2,D/b), and P the product of primes at most L. With c0=1/[2*pi^2*alpha*(1+(2*alpha)^(-2))], U=phi(P), G0=||d||1+||d_second||1/(4*pi^2), and A=||d||infty, gamma0=min(1,c0/[2*U*(1+G0)],1/[4*(1+A)]) is positive and depends on no scale or packet data. For all 0<gamma<=gamma0 the joint densities Q_h=P^(-1)(q0+gamma*C_P(h)*g) satisfy q0/(2P)<=Q_h<=3q0/(2P), each has mass 1/P, and their Fourier transform is qhat0(v)*1_P_divides_k+gamma*d(v)*1_gcd(abs(k),P)=1 for every real v and signed integer k.

Under the full input hypotheses of lem:signal, fix an integer c separating the full nonzero index ranges, any bounded smooth real circle jitter J strictly increasing on a good arc, and a smooth cutoff psi compactly supported there. The explicit rounded volume-preserving coordinate passage gives physical map/inverse smooth convergence and finite retained packet L2 transport O(1/N) to psi times the input, with spare-independent output moduli and separated angular supports. For each packet with spare-independent stationary weight w, its unfolded density differs in L1 by at most C/N for all sufficiently large integers N from w(s)*P_s[J_*(psi^2 da)](Ns). The proof removes the O(1/N) rounding shift at coefficient-mass level before pushforward and never translates the fast argument. routes.retired_because: At finite c, ell*m*t need not be integral, so the discrete phase is not a residue character and exact sieve cancellation fails. The manuscript itself avoids this shortcut. Use a finite-c perturbation bound instead; no refutation of the manuscript follows.
